proposal.hypothesis: Adding diagnose-first-error and incremental re-run guidance to the solve prompt reduces non-zero-exit implementation failures.
targetFailureModes: release-only crashes masked in debug builds
proposal.expectedBehaviorChange: Solve-mode prompt text additionally directs first-error diagnosis and incremental re-runs; no tools, services or section inventory change.
regressionRisks: The added guidance may lengthen solve sessions on simple tasks by encouraging extra re-runs.

mechanismAssertions: In solve mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:identity.
The solve section text prescribes diagnosing the first reported compiler or runtime error before re-running.
In propose mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:proposal-policy.
preservationAssertions: Disposing the candidate fiber removes the registered section and restores the pre-boot inventory exactly.
